title: SpecRunnerEvidenceView
description: `spec-runner evidence <run_id> --json` (#480 FR-09): one run as the store knows it. Built by the same `collect()` as the text output. A run-start without a closure is always `crash/unknown` -- a live process cannot be told from a dead one, so the view says so instead of guessing.

missing.description: What a legacy run lacks to carry the evidence contract; empty otherwise.

run_start.description: The run-start record (subcommand, policy identity, repository identity, ...), verbatim; null when absent.

closure.description: The closure record, verbatim; null without one. Validates against run-closure.schema.json.

last_checkpoint.description: The newest checkpoint whose manifest the store acknowledged.

timestamp.description: Null: the manifest carries no clock.

open_calls.description: Calls with a call-start and no call-result.

cost_usd.description: A number, or the string `unknown` when the record carries none.

calls.description: call_ids of the call records of this attempt.

key.description: Store key of the attempt's JSONL.

total_cost_usd.description: Sum of the known costs of the run's paid calls.

unpriced_calls.description: Calls whose cost is unknown (no result, or none reported).

deletions.description: Keys of the run's deletion records.

storage_cost.description: Present only when the adapter reports it.

unprovable.description: `не доказуемо: <причина>` where the data to decide is missing.
